Scholarship eligibility is strictly based on final scores secured in the last qualifying examination. No dual scholarships permitted. 3. Candidates must appear and qualify CUEE (Centurion University Entrance Examination). 4. Mandatory verification of original scorecard by university team. 5. Final scholarship eligibility list is published after approval by the University Scholarship Committee.

records.information: Centurion University follows the Choice-Based Credit System (CBCS). B.Tech programs span 4 academic years (8 semesters), while M.Tech, MBA, and MCA span 2 academic years (4 semesters). Each semester includes theory lectures, laboratory practicals, domain skill tracks, projects, and internships.

Academic assessment comprises continuous internal evaluation (assignments, quizzes, laboratory assessments, and mid-term exams) combined with end-semester university examinations. Grading is awarded on a 10-point CGPA scale.

Students must complete semester subject registration at the beginning of each term. A minimum of 80% class attendance is mandatory across all subjects to sit for semester examinations and maintain scholarship benefits.

Students submit their semester examination forms through the university student ERP portal after verifying their registered subjects. Timetables and hall tickets are issued by the Examination Cell prior to examination dates.

records.information: Backlog and supplementary examinations are scheduled alongside regular semester examinations. Students with backlogs must apply via the Examination Cell notification and pay the prescribed per-paper backlog examination fee before the published deadline.
